messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: GGIR version 1.10-4 now online
parts:
GGIR version 1.10-4 is now online.
This version addresses a bug that was introduced in version 1.10-1 as released only two weeks ago. The bug affected the output of part 4 and part 5 output.

Further, I have added functionality to read a broader range of csv file structures, which is relevant if you are working with accelerometer brands other than the those mentioned in the GGIR documentation.

Best, Vincent

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: GGIR version 1.10-4 now online
parts:
It seems there is an installation issue for OSx (mac).
This will be fixed in the next GGIR release, for the time being those who use a mac can insttall GGIR directly from GitHub with the following steps:

Open R(Studio)
Go to the console window and do the following steps. If at any stage you are asked what package depencies to install, type 1 (All) followed by pressing Enter.
Type: install.packages("devtools", depencies = TRUE)
Press Enter
Type: library(devtools)
Press Enter 
Type: install_github("wadpac/GGIR")
Press Enter   
Type: packageVersion("GGIR")
Press Enter  

If you have any problems then let me know.
Best, Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: GGIR version 1.10-4 now online
parts:
This issue usually occurs in the few days in between a new release of an R package and the release of its Windows binaries.
Further you may need to actively remove the package, restart R, and install it again.
I have uploaded GGIR version 1.10-7 to CRAN yesterday, which should address the issue with the OSx flavor on CRAN.
Vincent
